description:
Huge Thanks to Ayham for hosting us through Iraq. If you are interested in Iraq travel check out his Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ayhamf.j?igsh=amhjNmprcXJvcTA3

After leaving Iran, I finally met Flo again in Baghdad, Iraq. With the help of a friend of a friend of a friend we met up with Ayham. A local Iraqi who was willing to show us Baghdad through his eyes. 
Join us on this journey through the heart of ancient Mesopotamia 🎬
